title: What does the strategy game (made by RPG Maker ) look like?

posts.author: Gunz
posts.body:
Following my knowledge, RPG Maker usually fits to create the turn-based RPG games and adventure games. Some developers will create visual novels with it.
However, I don't know what we can create with RPG maker, excluding these three gameplay (but don't need to mod the software too much)?
Personally, I love strategy games. However, I can't imagine what a strategy game made by RPG Maker will look like.
Has anyone released some good strategy games (RPG Maker)? Can you introduce some to me?
Thank you very much.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Symphony of War: the Nephilim Saga is the professionally released one I'm aware of.
But frankly, turning RPG Maker games into strategy games takes a lot of complex plugins and technical knowledge of the engine.
There are other game-making engines that are designed to do it more easily.

posts.author: ZombieKidzRule
posts.body:
I don’t know what your definition of strategy game is, but just addressing your question about types of games made in RPG Maker, I’m currently making a Sudoku game.
From my experience, RPG Maker MZ is extremely versatile.

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
ZombieKidzRule said:
I don’t know what your definition of strategy game is
Click to expand...
Strategy is a standard category of video games. In the context of RPG Maker, I assume the OP is asking about making an SRPG such as Shining Force, Fire Emblem, Final Fantasy Tactics, etc.
It seems unlikely that they'd be trying to use RPG Maker to make an RTS or something (although anything is possible!)

posts.author: cyclesgame282
Marston
posts.body:
I know of at least 2 strategy games that were released in the german community. Both are entirely in german though, so no idea if they are any good for you.
First Fantasy
This is a RPG Maker 2000 game which was made for a RTP contest in 2008. The story doesn't take itself seriously, but the gameplay is pretty cool (and funnily enough, a whole serious scenario is also hidden on a map with all dialogues). I recorded some videos of the first few missions if you are interested in how it looks. And no, the game has no Fire Emblem music, I added that to the game myself. xD
Jael
Another german tactical RPG, this one was never finished though. It has like 20 chapters with route choices with unique battle maps inbetween (so in total its more like 30 unique chapters). It's pretty cool and was made with RPG Maker 2003 if I remember correctly.
...and I think someone also tried to make Command & Conquer with RPG Maker 2000 which apparently actually worked. At least until you got like more than 6 units on screen, then everything lagged so hard it became unplayable. That was never released though, I only remember screenshots from a forum back in, oof, 2005 maybe? So that was maaaaany years ago. No idea if the forum or the screens still exist though.
